outcome: Presence of mucus or blood on the catheter
cohort: 194 patients with previous delivery undergoing IVF/ICSI-ET
finding: Embryo transfers took longer in patients with a prior cesarean delivery and were more likely to have mucus or blood on the catheter, but pregnancy outcomes were not different between those with and without a prior cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Although embryo transfers were potentially more difficult in patients with a prior cesarean delivery, this did not negatively impact pregnancy outcomes.
